title: Actual versus forecast difference
intent: Show where an actual series is above or below a forecast while preserving exact interpolated crossings.

ai.create: Create an actual-versus-forecast difference chart. Plot may use differenceY; TanStack must interpolate every crossing and pass typed positive and negative lobes to areaY.
ai.maintain: Change the two series without losing exact crossing boundaries, semantic colors, explicit scales, or cast-free channels.
